post.description: Creates an initial immutable content version and a short-lived upload session. Declared metadata is untrusted; the returned FileReference is not usable until trusted inspection and malware scanning make the content available.

201.description: Durable session and ephemeral upload grant. An identical replay returns the original file/content/session identities but mints a fresh short-lived upload grant bounded by the original session expiry; it never extends durable lifetime.

get.description: Reads one exact immutable release after current resource authorization. It does not resolve a mutable current version.

post.description: Validates a proposed value against one exact immutable release on the server. The value is not persisted, authorization and domain invariants are not inferred, and client validation never becomes authoritative.

schema.description: The complete encoded request body is limited to 262144 bytes. The data value is depth 1; each nested object/array value increases depth by 1. Data is limited to depth 32 and 10000 total object, array, and scalar value nodes including the data root by x-ai-crm-request-limits before authorization and service invocation.

404.description: Exact form release does not exist.

413.description: Request body exceeds 262144 bytes, JSON nesting exceeds 32 levels, or parsed JSON exceeds 10000 total object/array/scalar nodes. The Controller rejects it before authorization and before invoking Form Schema.
